metadata.title: Understanding ADHD: A Guidebook for People with ADHD and the People Who Care for Them
metadata.description: A comprehensive, evidence-based intelligent textbook on ADHD written for two readers at once: the person with ADHD and their caregivers — parents, partners, siblings, and friends. Covers the science, diagnosis, treatment, daily skills, emotional life, school and work, and family dynamics of ADHD, with emphasis on late diagnosis and ADHD in women.
metadata.creator: Arun Batchu
